mcqs.question: The India–France ATL Bridge, launched at India Innovates 2026 in Nice, is a collaboration between which organisations?
options: Atal Innovation Mission (NITI Aayog) and Dassault Systèmes Foundation
Atal Innovation Mission (NITI Aayog) and the National Museum of Denmark
Joint India–France AI Task Force and Dassault Systèmes Foundation
Indian People's Forum UAE and Atal Innovation Mission (NITI Aayog)
mcqs.explanation: The India–France ATL Bridge was launched at India Innovates 2026 in Nice by the Atal Innovation Mission of NITI Aayog and the Dassault Systèmes Foundation. The National Museum of Denmark, the Joint India–France AI Task Force and the Indian People’s Forum UAE are not the stated partners of this initiative.

mcqs.question: India and France have shared their Strategic Partnership since which year?
mcqs.explanation: India and France have had a Strategic Partnership since 1998. The years 1992, 2016 and 2030 refer to other developments or timelines in the related current-affairs context, not the beginning of this partnership.
